finding.summary: Newly-lexable unbounded REFERENCE tokens (A:A, 1:1, A1:B) reach parseRange/parseRef in call sites that were not updated (e.g. extractFormulaRanges), likely throwing 'Invalid Reference' on a live UI path
finding.evidence: The grammar change makes `A:A`/`1:1`/`A1:B` valid REFERENCE tokens everywhere, but the only new guard is inside `expandUnboundedRanges` (formula.ts) which is wired into `calculate()` and `buildDependantsMap` only. docs/design/sheets/formula.md claims "Whole-column/row highlighting (`extractFormulaRanges`) skips unbounded refs", yet the diff contains no change to `extractFormulaRanges` — it still parses every REFERENCE token via `parseRange`, and `parseRange('A:A')` → `parseRef('A')`, which has no row and cannot match the ref pattern. Highlighting runs on every keystroke, so an uncaught throw here breaks formula editing. Same exposure for `shiftFormula`/`shiftSref` on row/column insert and any other `toSrefs(extractReferences(...))` caller that was not given the expansion.
